about.title: About U2Tool
about.intro: U2Tool is a comprehensive collection of free online tools designed for developers, designers, and everyday users. Our mission is to provide fast, secure, and easy-to-use utilities that run entirely in your browser.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: We believe that essential developer tools should be free and accessible to everyone. U2Tool was created to provide a one-stop solution for common tasks like encoding, formatting, generating, and converting data without requiring any software installation or account registration.

features.title: Key Features
features.free: 100% Free - All tools are completely free to use with no hidden costs
features.privacy: Privacy First - All processing happens in your browser, your data never leaves your device

technology.title: Technology
technology.content: U2Tool is built with modern web technologies including Next.js, React, and TypeScript. We prioritize performance, accessibility, and user experience in everything we build.
